title: Visible lakes of Kazakhstan
description: Few lakes are visible on Kazakh coverage: Lake Balkhash along the M36, seen from a road with barren brown surroundings; the lakes around Karaganda, with a late-summer feel of slightly orange shrubs and grass away from the main roads; Lake Shchuchinsk (Burabay area), surrounded by Scots pines; and the lakes around Petropavl, with lush, very green spring-like vegetation.

title: Wide unpaved A26 road
description: The A26 in Kazakhstan is very recognisable: unpaved, very wide and in very good condition. It has two sections with very different orientations, making it relatively easy to pinpoint.
